identifiers: Fully qualified project.dataset.resource validated before use. No requested text becomes an SQL identifier or expression.

view_columns.id: STRING: exact signed BIGINT decimal source activity ID, unique, no floating-point conversion
view_columns.created_at: DATETIME: exact source USE_TZ=False wall datetime; never interpret as UTC or shift the date
view_columns.created_at_mysql: STRING: exact MySQL implicit datetime string used by source icontains, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss at verified physical DATETIME(0) precision
view_columns.actor_exists: BOOL: current source operator row exists; inactive operators remain present
view_columns.actor_first_name: STRING NULL: current raw operator first_name, <=150 characters; NULL only if actor_exists=false
view_columns.actor_last_name: STRING NULL: current raw operator last_name, <=150 characters; NULL only if actor_exists=false
view_columns.platform: STRING: raw source VARCHAR(255), latin1_swedish_ci; retain trailing spaces
view_columns.comment: STRING NULL: raw source VARCHAR(255), latin1_swedish_ci; visible physical column is NOT NULL while Django model allows NULL
view_columns.recipient: STRING NULL: raw source VARCHAR(45), latin1_swedish_ci; retain null, empty and whitespace-only distinctions

comparison_routine.signature: (value STRING, term STRING, field_tag STRING) RETURNS BOOL
comparison_routine.platform.in: Source MySQL platform IN equality using latin1_swedish_ci and its PAD SPACE behavior. Case/accent weights must match that collation; leading spaces remain significant.
comparison_routine.recipient.icontains: Source MySQL recipient LIKE term using physical latin1_swedish_ci and backslash escape semantics. NULL never matches. LIKE does not apply equality PAD SPACE trimming.
comparison_routine.comment.icontains: Source MySQL comment LIKE term using physical latin1_swedish_ci and backslash escape semantics. NULL never matches.
comparison_routine.platform.icontains: Source MySQL platform LIKE term using physical latin1_swedish_ci and backslash escape semantics.
comparison_routine.created_at.icontains: Source MySQL implicit datetime LIKE behavior against created_at_mysql, including the verified source connection character-set/collation. Do not filter the ISO JSON timestamp instead.
comparison_routine.term_for_in: One normalized platform label, bound through @platforms. Source comma splitting/entity removal/Python whitespace stripping occurs in the backend before binding.
comparison_routine.term_for_icontains: Bound @pattern begins/ends with percent. Every original percent, underscore and backslash is escaped literally; double quotes have already become single quotes.
prohibited_shortcuts: LOWER or Unicode case folding as a guessed replacement
comparison_routine.deployment: Deploy a reviewed persistent scalar SQL or JavaScript UDF with the source-equivalent weights/escaping. No guessed routine is shipped or silently substituted. Execute the native source vectors against the deployed routine before enabling it. A missing required routine returns 503 without historical MySQL fallback.

integrity_and_routing: Exactly one activity row per ID; join a current operator dimension with exact source names, including inactive rows and missing-operator state.
All-history views include both old and newly created activity; a historical-only archive is insufficient for no-date requests.
Publish the activity and operator-dimension projection as a coherent query snapshot. Verify updates, deletes and source ingestion completeness before acceptance.
Only from=to=current BUSINESS_TIMEZONE day may use the data reader. Every no-date, previous-day, mixed-day and future-day request uses BigQuery exclusively.
Dates bind half-open wall DATETIME bounds. An inclusive 9999-12-31 upper endpoint has no representable next day and binds no upper bound.
One bound SELECT returns filtered count plus at most requested length (1..500) rows ordered by exact numeric ID.
Invalid, non-aligned or out-of-range source offsets resolve to first page. Both totals equal the filtered count.
The adapter rejects malformed counts, duplicate/reordered IDs, incomplete pages and numeric IDs. A missing/failed warehouse never triggers a reader fallback.
Current internal role1-3 authorization is checked on the writer before report access. History is globally scoped because the source table has no store_id.

physical_design_to_verify.review: Confirm partition pruning through the configured view, literal-comparison correctness, current operator dimension freshness, billing cap, runtime, all-history cost and restrictive warehouse IAM. No BigQuery DDL, live query or latency claim occurred.

executed_local_evidence.source_runtime: Django4.2.5 + PyMySQL1.1.1, local MySQL8.4.11, exact source methods extracted after baseline hash verification
executed_local_evidence.limits: Historical vectors validate bound adapter/reducer behavior using fixture warehouse responses sourced from real MySQL. They do not execute BigQuery SQL or certify a deployed comparison routine.
